name: Market Research Agent
summary: Turns a research objective into a structured market report where every claim points to a source.
description: A researcher agent searches the web with the model provider's web search tool (opt-in, see WORKFLOWS_WEB_SEARCH) and writes notes. With Anthropic, cited passages come from the search tool; with OpenAI, whose search returns links only, the top results are read on this computer (WORKFLOWS_WEB_FETCH) and passages are quoted word for word from those pages. A writer agent turns only the retrieved sources into a structured report, and deterministic checks verify that every finding, player and trend cites a source that was actually retrieved. A separate reviewer call grades whether the report answers the objective. If web search is off or returns nothing, the workflow stops and says so instead of inventing sources. This is a technical demonstration of the runtime, not a substitute for expert research.
problems: I need to understand a market before entering it
I don't know how big the opportunity is or who the main players are
I want a sourced overview of trends in my industry
I need evidence for a go-to-market decision

inputs.label: Research objective
inputs.description: The question this research should answer.
inputs.example: How large is the market for AI bookkeeping tools for US agencies, and who leads it?

outputs.label: Research report
outputs.description: Executive summary, market overview, key players, trends, risks and open questions.

outputs.label: Findings with sources
outputs.description: Each finding with the source URLs that support it.

steps.name: Search and take notes
steps.responsibility: Run up to 5 web searches for the objective and write research notes with citations.

steps.name: Write report
steps.responsibility: Draft a structured report using only the retrieved sources, citing each item by source id.

steps.name: Verify sources
steps.responsibility: Confirm required sections are present and every cited source id was actually retrieved.

steps.name: Review
steps.responsibility: A separate reviewer grades whether the report answers the objective (1-5 rubric).

tools.purpose: Retrieve current public information about the market.
Read the top search results when the provider's search returns links only (OpenAI).

criteria.description: All required report sections are present and substantive.
Every finding, key player and trend cites a retrieved source.
The report directly addresses the research objective.
